# Patch transform to crop all-grid-color endpoint lattice lines on both ends.
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(r).most_common(1)[0][0] for r in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    candidates = [x for x in set(row_modes) & set(col_modes) if row_modes.count(x) >= 2 and col_modes.count(x) >= 2]
    line_color = min(candidates, key=lambda x: min(row_modes.count(x), col_modes.count(x)))
    rs = [i for i,x in enumerate(row_modes) if x == line_color]
    cs = [j for j,x in enumerate(col_modes) if x == line_color]
    while len(rs) > 2 and all(grid[rs[0]][c] == line_color for c in cs): rs.pop(0)
    while len(rs) > 2 and all(grid[rs[-1]][c] == line_color for c in cs): rs.pop()
    while len(cs) > 2 and all(grid[r][cs[0]] == line_color for r in rs): cs.pop(0)
    while len(cs) > 2 and all(grid[r][cs[-1]] == line_color for r in rs): cs.pop()
    rset,cset=set(rs),set(cs)
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in rset for c in range(w) if c not in cset]
    bg = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0] if interior else 0
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c,d in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            vals=[grid[a][c],grid[a][d],grid[b][c],grid[b][d]]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals.count(vals[0])==4 and vals[0] != line_color else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
print(transform(d1)); print(transform(d2))
